cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only dealing with the messages. Are you happy for a few people to join us for dinner tonight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll keep those for us. I can arrange the guests around the table once I know how formal you want it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests have you invited?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six; they've all said yes. I'll borrow six chairs. With somewhere for everyone to sit, can I tell them you're happy I invited them?
